settings.cache.title: Thumbnail cache
settings.cache.enabled.help: Keeps the embedded previews and photo details on disk. Photos that you imported before then show immediately. Edited photos keep their rendered thumbnails in a different cache.
settings.sfd_cache.title: SFD cache
settings.sfd_cache.help: Fused SFD .X3I RAWs are stored in their own cache, separate from thumbnails. Clearing the SFD cache does not delete your original X3I files and edits. You can always re-fuse SFD RAWs from the original X3I file.
settings.sfd_cache.clear_failed: Could not clear the SFD cache. If an SFD RAW is fusing, wait for it to finish and try again.
settings.save_alongside_original.help: When enabled, exported files will be saved alongside the original files.
settings.save_alongside_original.descrip: Disable to choose a custom output directory.
settings.only_convert_new: Only export new items in the queue
settings.only_convert_new.help: When enabled, 'Export All' will only process files that haven't been exported yet. When disabled, it will process all files in the queue, including those already exported.
settings.raw_compression.help: Enable lossless compression for DNGs and TIFFs
settings.raw_compression.warning: RAW Compressed DNGs may not open in some apps. If you encounter issues, disable compression.
settings.denoise.help: Enable or disable noise reduction during export
settings.concurrency.help: Auto chooses a value based on your processor. Higher values use more CPU and memory.
settings.dng_highlight_recovery.help: Recover blown highlights in Merrill-generation DNGs
settings.dng_highlight_recovery.warning: Highlight recovery may cause DNGs to render incorrectly in some apps. If you encounter issues, disable recovery.
settings.cineon.help: Use a Cineon-style flat tone curve for TIFF output
settings.color_mode.help: Applies a Sigma Photo Pro color mode to the TIFF image. Merrill cameras support Standard to FOV Classic Blue. dp Quattro cameras support all modes. If a photo cannot use the mode, such as a photo shot in Monochrome, the export uses Standard. Other cameras export without a color mode. DNG exports always include every color mode as a camera profile.
settings.x3i_source.help: For Super Fine Detail X3I files. The SFD RAW fuses every exposure, which takes about 30 seconds and up to 3 GB of RAM for each file. The unfused RAW uses one frame and needs no fuse. Other files ignore this setting.
settings.debug_logging.help: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting
settings.film_attribution: Film simulation: spektrafilm by Andrea Volpato, CC BY-SA 4.0, ported from spektrafilm-rs (GPL-3.0).

editor.savedBackup: Saved in app data — source folder is read-only
editor.fillLightHelp: Adds light to dark areas. Bright areas do not become overexposed. Negative values make dark areas darker.
editor.mixQualifierHelp: Pick a midtone to target {{color}} before film rendering. Adjusts all three output rows and keeps raw gains unchanged.
editor.mixQualifierHint: Click the photo to target {{color}}. Escape cancels.
editor.mixQualifierCannotFit: This sample cannot reach the target color within the mix limits. Choose a more distinct midtone.
editor.mixPadHelp: Center: equal mix. Outside the triangle: negative contributions. Arrow keys: 1%. Alt/Option: fine adjustment. Shift: larger steps. Delete: reset output.
editor.fullSpectrumNote: Full spectrum profiles are not intended to be used as-is and require manual white balance and channel mixing for best results.
editor.pickNeutral: Click a neutral gray area in the image.
editor.extendedRangeHelp: Uses relative blue/red Temperature and green/magenta Tint. Full spectrum starts with this enabled. Turn it off for Kelvin controls.
editor.extendedRangeUnavailable: This white balance exceeds the direct gain range. Adjust the normal white balance or reset to As Shot.
editor.whiteBalanceLoading: White balance is still loading. Try again when the preview is ready.
editor.perspectiveVerticalHelp: Tilts the picture forward or back. Positive values widen the top, for buildings that lean in.
editor.perspectiveHorizontalHelp: Turns the picture left or right. Positive values enlarge the right side.
editor.negativePreviewHelp: Shows the negative inverted, as a positive. Only the view changes; exports keep the negative.
editor.halationLookHelp: Add light scattering and a glow around bright areas, as in film.
editor.renderedExportHint: Exports the saved adjustments; unedited photos use default development. DNG and embedded JPEG remain original exports.
export.resize.help: Fits the image inside the maximum width and height. The aspect ratio does not change. Smaller images are not enlarged.
editor.cropCanvas: Drag the corners to resize, or inside the frame to move it. Drag just outside the frame to rotate; hold Shift to snap to 15°. Arrow keys nudge; Return applies; Escape cancels.
editor.filmHelp: Simulates exposing the photo onto real film and printing it on paper.
editor.monochromeHelp: Red darkens blue skies and green lightens foliage, like colored filters on black-and-white film.
editor.scopeQualifyHint: Click a point or drag a rectangle in the image to measure it. In the focused image, arrow keys move a point, Shift with arrow keys sizes a rectangle, Return applies, and Escape cancels.
editor.halationHelp: Enable light scattering inside the emulsion and reflections from the film base.
editor.couplersHelp: Interaction between the film's color layers. Higher values give richer color and crisper edges.
editor.gammaFilmHelp: Contrast of the developed negative. Unlike paper contrast, it also shifts color.
editor.gammaPaperHelp: Like printing on a harder or softer paper grade.
editor.evPaperHelp: Brightens or darkens the print without re-exposing the film.
editor.vibranceHelp: Boosts muted colors more than already saturated ones.
editor.denoiseHelp: Works on the RAW sensor data, so the preview updates when you release the slider.
editor.curveHint: Click to add a point. Drag to shape the smooth curve through the points; double-click a point to remove it.
editor.curveQualifierHelp: Hover over the photo to see where its pixels fall on the curve. Click to add a point there.
editor.curveQualifierHint: Click the photo to add a point. Escape cancels.
denoise.channelsHelp: Luminance controls grain; chroma controls color noise. Both off leaves sensor denoising disabled.
denoise.windowsHelp: Odd sizes in pixels. Larger searches cost more time; larger patches can soften detail. The low-frequency chroma pass uses a 21-pixel search.
denoise.bm3dHelp: BM3D can take several seconds on full-resolution RAWs. NLM gives faster previews.
editor.sfdAbout: An SFD RAW fuses 7 bracketed RAW files into one RAW with remarkable dynamic range and low noise.
editor.legacyFilmEffect: This photo uses previous effect controls. Reset this effect to use Spektrafilm controls.
editor.grainRmsGranularityHelp: Film density variation measured through a 48 µm aperture (RMS × 1000). Higher values produce coarser grain. Moves all RGB channels together and keeps their offsets. The range stops when a channel reaches 0 or 100.
editor.grainBlurHelp: Gaussian blur of the sampled grain, in output pixels (sigma). The default is 0.7. Higher values also soften image detail.
editor.grainSharpenHelp: Restores detail after grain blur with a density unsharp mask. 0 disables it; the default is 1.5. The radius stays at 0.7 pixels.
editor.scatterAmountHelp: The fraction of light scattered inside the emulsion. 0 disables scattering; 1 applies the stock’s physical scattering.
editor.scatterSpatialScaleHelp: Scales the width of both the narrow and wide scattering. 1 uses the stock’s physical sizes; 0 removes the spread.
editor.halationAmountHelp: Scales light reflected from the film base. 1 uses the stock’s physical strength; 0 removes halation while keeping scattering.
editor.halationSpatialScaleHelp: Scales the spread of reflected light. 1 uses the stock’s physical size. This does not change the reflection strength.
editor.grainChannelOffsetHelp: Add or subtract grain intensity from the main value for each color channel. Zero uses the main value. Each channel stays between 0 and 100.
export.mixed_description: The selected images have different export settings. Overwrite them with the settings for {{name}}, or cancel to keep only that image selected.
export.partial_highlight_recovery: Highlight recovery applies only to the selected Merrill images.
export.partial_sfd_source: This setting applies only to the selected X3I images.
export.dng_rendered_only: DNG photos export only as rendered JPEG or 16-bit TIFF images with their adjustments.
